strategicPlan: Our strategic assessment reveals a rapidly converging and escalating global risk landscape. While the baseline global threat level is 1, a confluence of persistent geopolitical conflicts, notably the war in Iran, is accelerating an unprecedented energy crisis and exacerbating global food insecurity through systemic nutrient depletion and overfishing, creating profound resource strain. This resource precarity is mirrored by market volatility in key tech sectors, underscored by evolving cyber threats from AI-enhanced 'script kiddies' and significant internal disruption within the AI industry. Concurrently, a concerning surge in seismic activity across the Caribbean and the Pacific Ring of Fire signals heightened physical risks to infrastructure and populations in these active geological zones. To secure assets and ensure physical safety in this complex environment, we must urgently diversify and localize essential resource supply chains to build resilience against geopolitical and environmental shocks; immediately bolster cyber defenses against increasingly sophisticated, AI-enabled threats by conducting thorough system audits and employee training; and proactively review and reinforce physical infrastructure while updating comprehensive emergency preparedness plans for all personnel and assets situated in seismically active areas.
